name: dictopen
description: Dictopen — dictée médicale : transcription vocale par l'API OpenAI, collage dans l'application active, SpeechMike, mode Courrier

scripts.install-mac: npm run package && rm -rf '/Applications/Dictopen.app' && cp -R 'out/Dictopen-darwin-arm64/Dictopen.app' /Applications/ && cp icon.icns '/Applications/Dictopen.app/Contents/Resources/electron.icns' && ([ -x $HOME/dev/sign-mac.sh ] && $HOME/dev/sign-mac.sh '/Applications/Dictopen.app' || codesign --force --deep -s - '/Applications/Dictopen.app') && codesign --verify --deep --strict '/Applications/Dictopen.app'
